new_results.detail: Infinite SAT and UNSAT fixed-point families survive BCE; the same families survive matching-lean+BCE composition.
General autarky lean kernel N_a(F) is empty iff F is SAT; polynomial computation of N_a for arbitrary CNF is equivalent to P=NP.
Explicit connected SAT linearly-lean families and UNSAT lean families both have nonempty linear kernel; linear autarkies do not recover general lean-kernel emptiness.
Polynomial exact normalization to mu_vd<=nM(sigma) can stall on SAT and UNSAT; LEAN remains coNP-complete already at surplus 1. The witness-autarky step is isolated as MLCR/Conjecture 10.3.

For Boolean MLCR clause-sets of maximum width <=3 a satisfying assignment is deterministically polynomial-time constructible. Consequently Kullmann-Zhao Conjecture 10.3 holds for Boolean width<=3 CNFs, yielding a proof-carrying exact autarky step whenever the surplus/min-degree trigger fires.
proof_core: For k>=2, nM(k)>=k+2, hence n<=3 and exhaustive search is constant in variable count.
For k=1, matching leanness gives delta*=1; enumerate at most one-variable partial assignments and use maximum matching to construct a matching-satisfying completion.

current_frontier.remaining_goal: Find an exact polynomial transition that also acts on every residual 3CNF where the autarky trigger does not fire, with polynomially bounded universal strict descent.
